Name: JB's Fixed Folks
Author: thebigjb
Description:
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/205777536-1725566648.png[/img]

This mod combines all of my mods that change or fix character sprites into one handy mod:

[list]
[*]Amended Abigail
[*]Goodbye Goofy Gus
[*]Handsomer Harvey
[*]Jazzed-up Jodi
[*]Leveled-up Leah
[*]Modified Maru
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/205777536-1724455214.png[/img]﻿

Using GMCM, decide which mod you want to use. They're all turned on by default.


[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/205777536-1724455177.png[/img]

1) GMCM interface for enabling/disabling sprite changes.
2) Sprite changes for all seasons:
[list]
[*]Removes bow-legs for Abigail, Jodi, Leah, and Maru.
[*]﻿Removes Abigail's bow.
[*]Gives Harvey a moustache and improves his hair and glasses.
[*]Removes Gus's "Durrrr" appearance.
[*]Gives Maru glasses.
[*]Two versions of Maru's hospital outfit (one with red cross and one with original).
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/205777536-1718915106.png[/img]
[list=1]
[*]Download SMAPI, Content Patcher, and GMCM
[*]Unzip them into your Mods folder
[*]Download Fixed Folks and unzip into your mod folder
[*]Launch the game, go to the GMCM menu and choose which mod to load
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/205777536-1718914618.png[/img]
[list]
[*]SMAPI
[*]Content Patcher
[*]GMCM (Optional but strongly recommended)
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/205777536-1718915534.png[/img]

Thanks to everyone who downloaded the individual mods and gave me such amazing feedback!
